activity.notes: Gaddafi resigned his formal GPC post on 2 March 1979 but retained ultimate political authority as the 'Leader of the Revolution'. The Jamahiriya's formal institutions did not remove his de facto supremacy. ATLAS therefore preserves a separate 1979-2011 de facto ruling Activity and ends it with the overthrow of the Gaddafi regime during the 2011 civil war, rather than with his earlier formal resignation.

sources.title: Libya: A Country Study — Library of Congress / Federal Research Division
sources.citation_text: The country study states that Qadhafi relinquished his formal governmental position in 1979, thereafter used the title Leader of the Revolution, and nevertheless remained the country's dominant political authority.

sources.title: Libya after Qaddafi: Lessons and Implications for the Future — RAND / Library of Congress
sources.citation_text: The Library of Congress catalog summary describes the 2011 rebel overthrow of longstanding Libyan dictator Muammar Qaddafi and the post-Qaddafi transition.
